test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
A statement and two possible conclusions I and II are given below. Read the information carefully and choose the correct option.

Statement:

After the recession in country F, many small companies have decided to retrench all the employees who were on a six-month probation period. As a result, a little more than 48% of the employees of company M were laid off.

Which of the following conclusions can be drawn on the basis of the given information?

I. The number of employees in company M has almost doubled recently.

II. Retrenchment due to recession is not based on performance (of employees).

options.text: Only conclusion I can be drawn from the given information.
Neither I nor II can be concluded from the given information.
Both conclusions I and II can be drawn from the given information.
Only conclusion II can be drawn from the given information.

solution:
Given,

Statement:

After the recession in country F, many small companies have decided to retrench all the employees who were on a six-month probation period. As a result, a little more than 48% of the employees of company M were laid off.

Conclusions:

I. The number of employees in company M has almost doubled recently - **False** (Because, the statement does not mention anything about the number of employees in company M doubling recently. It only mentions that a little more than 48% of the employees were laid off).

II. Retrenchment due to recession is not based on performance (of employees) - **True** (Because, the statement mentions that the retrenchment decision was based on the probation period and not on the performance of the employees).

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
